conviction_note: The reported quarter is mechanical (about +$1.05-1.1B fair-value gain on 43,514 BTC as BTC rose ~43% in Q3) and already in the public BTC tape. The only new content the window can carry is the first earnings call and the 'fuller update later this year' the CEO promised in August, against a stock at about 0.63x equity NAV that management itself called a misallocation. The sign of a strategy update is genuinely uncertain (buyback/capital return would be bought; a related-party Tether/Elektron deal paid in discounted stock might not), so p_up sits at 53 and abs_move at 6 (daily vol 3.8%, strategic news has moved it +6.6% and -14% this year, plus overnight BTC). The findings sum (+0.7) and the scaled number (+0.36) agree in sign and are both small.
bar: unsourced: no consensus EPS found on any aggregator (searched; equibles, defillama and mirror pages carry none). The company gives no guidance and has no revenue. findings.finding: Q3 2026 will show the company's first large profit: BTC rose about 43% in Q3 (CoinGlass via Cointelegraph, ~$58.6k to ~$83.6-85k), so the fair-value gain on 43,514 BTC is about +$1.09-1.15B against the Q2 loss of $413.5M and Q1 loss of $859.7M; net income roughly +$1.0-1.1B, ~+$3 per Class A share, against no published consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 fair-value loss release (10-Q accepted 10:31 ET 2026-08-11) traded +1% in the first hour and closed -1.7% at $4.50 (The Block / TradingView via crypto.news); i.e. the mark-to-market line barely moves the stock. Baseline history is empty and flagged untrustworthy.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: anyone with the BTC price and the 43,514 holding can compute it, and the stock has since fallen 24% as BTC gave back ~12% of the quarter's gain. What could be unpriced is only headline/algo reaction to a '$1B+ profit' print on a name with no consensus; if that were priced there would be visible pre-print buying, and instead the 20-day run-up is -15.6%.
findings.independence: Holding and June mark from the Q2 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2070457/000121390026087471/ea0299640-10q_twentyone.htm); Q3 BTC return also in https://cryptobriefing.com/bitcoin-q3-up-44-best-quarter/ . Same underlying fact (the BTC price), so one finding.

findings.finding: The CEO's 11 Aug 2026 shareholder letter (8-K Ex. 99.1) promised 'a fuller update later this year' and said of the stock's 0.7x enterprise mNAV discount 'That gap could be viewed as a misallocation of capital; we share that view'; the 13 Nov call is the company's first-ever earnings call and the first scheduled venue for that update, with the stock now at ~0.63x equity NAV and $106M cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Strategic news is what has moved XXI this year: Tether's merger proposal (2026-04-29) +6.6% after hours (The Block); Strike exit and Mallers resignation (2026-07-21) -14% to $4.54 (The Block). The August letter with the five priorities but no concrete action closed -1.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The content of the update is unknown to everyone; the letter contains no buyback or capital-return commitment, so a concrete discount-closing action (buyback, BTC-funded repurchase, lending launch) would be new. If the market expected one, the stock would not have fallen 24% since 2 Oct, faster than BTC, into the call. The downside case is equally live: a vague update after three months repeats the August -1.7%, and a Tether related-party deal paid in stock below NAV would dilute BTC per share.
findings.independence: Same message reported independently at the time (https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/twenty-one-capital-stock-trades-below-value-of-its-bitcoin-holdings, 'provide a fuller strategy update before year-end'); first-call status from the company's 5 Nov release (https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-to-Host-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Call-on-Friday-November-13th-2026.pdf). CEO also spoke on 'Beyond a DAT' at Cantor Convergence on 12 Nov 13:15 ET (company release) and on 'Building the Bitcoin Operating Company' in Lugano 24 Oct; no coverage of what he said was found.

findings.finding: The Elektron Energy combination (Tether-controlled bitcoin miner, ~50 EH/s, ~5% of network, led until July by now-CEO Zagury) was still 'under evaluation' with 'no binding commitments' and no board evaluation per the Q2 10-Q; any deal would be a related-person transaction under Texas law, and the call could announce or shelve it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The original three-way Strike+Elektron proposal was bought +6.6% after hours on 2026-04-29; its partial collapse on 2026-07-21 was sold -14%.
findings.why_not_priced: No document since August updates the talks (EDGAR shows only a director appointment, a conference 8-K and Form 4s since). Sign is ambiguous: mining cash flow fits the 'operating company' plan the market has rewarded, but consideration in XXI stock at ~0.63x NAV to the controlling holder would dilute BTC per share, so the expected value is near zero with wide tails.
findings.independence: Elektron description and April proposal: https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-04-30-twenty-one-capital-merger-tether-399525 ; July status: https://theblock.co/news/business/2026-07-21-jack-mallers-leaves-twenty-one-as-strike-exits-tethers-three-way-bitcoin-merger-409075 ; TFTC (2026-07-29) framed Elektron as the main vehicle, https://www.tftc.io/twenty-one-capital-ceo-bitcoin-treasury-mnav-premium-compression .
